title: Remove or make reachable the native relay UpgradeRequired refusal reason
outcome: Remove or make reachable the native relay UpgradeRequired refusal reason
acceptance: The relay diagnostic model no longer advertises an unreachable UpgradeRequired reason, or an authenticated version-skew request receives correctly correlated safe upgrade guidance without weakening request validation.
A behavior test covers the chosen version-skew result; existing status, MAC, authority, 404 and outcome-uncertainty behavior is retained.
